column1: # Scenario requirements per stage and plan, parsed as data by tests/run.sh
# (never sourced) before any group of that stage or plan runs.
#       the proof's whole identity: scenarios.tsv row <id> is active and
#       proven by exactly <kind>/<group> <case>; that group runs there and
#       is registered in groups.tsv with exactly <file>;
#   count   <stage:NAME|plan:NAME> <n>   exactly n require rows for NAME;
#       every scenario row of that owner is active and runs there.
# The list must be complete: every active scenario whose group runs in a
# stage or plan is required there. This file is required. Edit it by hand,
# with its count row, when a mandatory proof is deliberately added, moved or
# retired; never regenerate it to make a failing stage pass.
